# x402 URL Normalizer

> Deterministic URL parsing, cleaning of tracking params, canonicalization, and component extraction for agents. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/normalize – service info
- POST /api/normalize – paid normalize

## Pricing

~0.003 – 0.01 USDC per call (default max 0.008 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "url": "https://example.com/path?utm_source=foo&id=123#hash",
  "options": {
    "stripTracking": true,
    "forceHttps": true,
    "lowercaseHost": true,
    "removeFragment": false,
    "sortQuery": true
  }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "normalized": "https://example.com/path?id=123",
  "components": {
    "protocol": "https:",
    "host": "example.com",
    "pathname": "/path",
    "searchParams": { "id": "123" },
    "hash": ""
  },
  "meta": { "trackingRemoved": ["utm_source"], "changed": true }
}
```

Ideal for autonomous agents deduplicating links, cleaning crawl results, or preparing URLs for storage/RAG.
